content: Which of today's products should I look at first?

Start with the Aurelia cat feather wand and the Brightleaf silicone bags. Both have 3 FBA sellers, 5-6% price movement over 90 days and ROI above 100% after fees. The Halcyon dog bowl is a close third. I'd skip the Zephyra fan: its price has dropped 31% in 90 days.
